wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap way 66645876 is the mapped palace building in the separately named Al Alam Palace enclosure (way 66647557, Q2121461). The exact mapped outer corners remain controls. The long straight rear wall registers the heading; the two semicircular recesses in the central south edge establish the public forecourt side.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the central cube, both long wings, four flared entrance columns, projecting roof, forecourt stairs and flagstaff. Near levels resolve the arches, flares and wall edges.
limitations: Masonry heights, spacing and exact placement of the gold and blue colors, column profiles and wing openings are estimates made from written descriptions and the mapped plan.
The original terrain is unmodified. Floor and threshold heights are estimated.
No photograph, drawing, pattern or texture was used. The Qualla photo’s file-level public-domain label does not resolve rights in the depicted architecture.
